final: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM rating_stats), kept AS (SELECT rs.avg_length, rs.avg_ratio, rs.avg_ratio - o.overall_avg AS difference FROM rating_stats rs CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE rs.avg_ratio > o.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_length), AVG(avg_ratio), AVG(difference) FROM kept
